CustomField.label: Skipped Checks
CustomField.description: Controls what happens to checks that are SKIPPED (they did not apply to this record). Show each check keeps them listed. Hide checks, show count only removes the skipped checks from the list; their count still appears in the summary bar at the bottom of the card.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Show each check = list every skipped check. Hide checks, show count only = remove skipped checks from the list; the count still shows in the summary bar.
